verdict.rationale: Phoenix offers prompt versioning, dataset versioning, and experiment comparison (docs-7, docs-40, docs-64, arize-phoenix-gh-1) which cover 'version' and 'review' for prompts/datasets, but there is no explicit concept of 'automations' (multi-step workflows) or a documented rollback mechanism beyond re-selecting a prior prompt version. missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow object with rollback, audit trail of automation changes, and evidence of rolling back a running automation rather than just prompts/datasets.
